Class H3RasterAggregator

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.data.H3RasterAggregator
public final class H3RasterAggregator extends Object

H3RasterAggregator

State-of-the-art spherical GIS aggregator transferring equirectangular rasters onto discrete Uber H3 hexagonal meshes (H3Cell) using resolution-adaptive conservative integration:

  • Coarse-to-Medium H3 Regime ($\text{pixels}/\text{hex} \ge 1.5$, e.g. $2048\times 1024$ onto H3 Res 0–4): Full parallel pixel-to-H3 spatial binning (with $2\times 2$ sub-pixel quadrature when $\text{pixels}/\text{hex} < 20$), guaranteeing deterministic fixed-order reduction and exact spherical area weighting ($\propto \cos\phi$):
    • Extensive fields (population density integral): $W_i = \sum_{s \in \text{hex}_i} \rho(s)\,A_{\text{sub}}(s)$, satisfying $\sum_{i \in \text{Globe}} W_i \equiv \sum_{x,y} \rho(x,y)\,A_{\text{px}}(y)$.
    • Intensive scalar fields (elevation, temperature, rainfall, seasonality, resources): $\bar{q}_i = \frac{\sum_{s \in \text{hex}_i} q(s)\,A_{\text{sub}}(s)}{\sum_{s \in \text{hex}_i} A_{\text{sub}}(s)}$.
    • Categorical biomes: spherical-area-weighted modal class $\arg\max_b \sum_{s \in \text{hex}_i} \mathbf{1}[b(s)=b]\,A_{\text{sub}}(s)$.
  • Fine H3 / High-Resolution Regime ($\text{pixels}/\text{hex} < 1.5$, e.g. H3 Res 5–10 regional windows): 7-point hexagonal Gauss-style cubature combined with continuous spherical bilinear interpolation of raster channels so sub-pixel gradients remain $C^0$-smooth without nearest-neighbor staircasing.

    computeGlobalDensityIntegral(BufferedImage densityImg)
    Computes the exact global spherical area integral of a density raster across all pixels: $$W_{\text{globe}} = \sum_{y=0}^{h-1} A_{\text{px}}(y) \sum_{x=0}^{w-1} \rho(x, y)$$ Mathematically invariant with respect to H3 grid resolution for resolution-independent conservation in windowed regional simulations.

    • aggregateDensityWeights

      public static double[] aggregateDensityWeights(BufferedImage densityImg, List<H3Cell> cells)
      Aggregates an empirical demographic density raster onto a target list of H3 cells, integrating density over each hexagon's spherical footprint ($\iint_{\text{hex}} \rho\,dA$). Falls back seamlessly to 7-point bilinear hexagonal cubature $\times \text{cellAreaKm2}$ for ultra-fine regional H3 resolutions or non-H3 synthetic cells.
      Parameters:
      densityImg - empirical population density raster (grayscale brightness $\in [0, 1]$)
      cells - target list of simulation cells
      Returns:
      deterministic array of integrated areal weights aligned with cells indices
